column1: # Columns (tab-separated): symbol  ensembl_gene_id  chrom  mva_locus  aliases
# The RUNTIME BED is derived from the GENCODE GTF by matching `gene_name` (the
# `symbol` column) against $MVA_GTF, then padding each gene by $PANEL_PAD bp —
# coordinates are NEVER hardcoded here, so this file stays assembly-agnostic.
# The `symbol` column is therefore the authoritative match key; ensembl_gene_id
# and aliases are informational. A `-` in ensembl_gene_id means "resolve via the
# GTF symbol" (kept blank rather than fabricate an unverified stable id).
# `chrom` is the chr-prefixed primary contig the gene lives on (documentation
# only; the real region comes from the GTF).
